source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: The Lion can send his **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** unit into **[Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** in your Command phase. The unit can still make an **[ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move)** during the [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) of that turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
